Name: Nyapu Style Portraits for NPC Eleanor
Author: chlkyy
Description:
[b]This mod has two files, a content patcher mod file and a direct png replacement file. To install the png replacement file, drag and drop the images in the corresponding folders and replace the base portraits. For the content patcher file, simply drag the file into your mods folder.[/b]

[b]Special thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/nyapu]Nyapu[/url] for their portraits, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/DolphinIsNotaFish?gameId=1303]DolphinIsNotaFish[/url] for the content patcher components, [/b][b]and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/StrojvedouciDenis]StrojvedouciDenis[/url] for the base mod![/b]
